notice: Desk study only. No real keys, certificates, TSA calls, or Gotenberg runs. expected_outcome values are documented or inferred, never observed.

scenarios.title: Sign with test self-signed key
scenarios.expected_outcome: Signed PDF returned; viewer flags self-signed as untrusted
scenarios.needs: test key generated by user in approved environment

scenarios.title: Append stage after sign (stamp/metadata)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Signature bytes retained; verifier validity/permission warning unknown
scenarios.basis: documented for retention; inferred for verifier result

scenarios.title: Encrypted PDF sign
steps: Decrypt then sign in separate request
scenarios.expected_outcome: One-request sign refused; two-step path required

scenarios.title: Key rotation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Old docs unchanged; validation depends on retained chain/validation data

scenarios.title: Expired certificate
steps: Verify doc signed while valid and timestamped
scenarios.expected_outcome: New signing fails or flagged; old timestamped doc may validate at signing time; Gotenberg behavior unknown

scenarios.title: Revoked certificate
steps: Revoke test cert in test CA
scenarios.expected_outcome: Whether Gotenberg checks revocation is unknown; app pre-check required (proposed)

scenarios.title: Validation failure triage
scenarios.expected_outcome: Verifier reports modified/untrusted/missing revocation data; signing success is not validation success
